summary: Add marketing_opt_in column with NOT NULL DEFAULT false via expand stage to ensure zero-downtime compatibility with the unmodified old Saleor version; backfill stage idempotently guarantees no NULLs; deploy_new with state_only records Django state without running the new version's migration on the existing schema; retire_old then contract finalize the change with both versions having served traffic.
write_consistency: The expand stage adds marketing_opt_in boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false; old version INSERTs/UPDATEs omit the column, receiving DB default false; new version explicitly writes the field; no NULLs are introduced during the concurrent overlap.

stages.description: Add marketing_opt_in column with NOT NULL DEFAULT false to account_user table.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

stages.description: Idempotently set any remaining NULLs in marketing_opt_in to false.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET marketing_opt_in = false WHERE marketing_opt_in IS NULL;

stages.description: Retire the old Saleor version; new version serves all traffic.
Finalize the column default confirmation after old version retirement.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN marketing_opt_in SET DEFAULT false;
